cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

confusable: Unlike generic optimism, A treats the specific loss as required learning; borrowed authority changes the plan so B can keep working with that interpretation.
comparison: Business debt after lost custom differs from personal sentimental loss and compensation.
